title: Langflow before 1.3.0 executes unauthenticated code via its validation endpoint
summary: Langflow before 1.3.0 exposes a code-validation endpoint that executes submitted Python without authentication. Any instance reachable by an attacker is fully compromised. An instance bound to the local machine only is not remotely reachable.

fixedBy.mitigation: Do not expose the instance; bind locally or place it behind authentication
